# Greeting

The fixture's one user-facing behavior is producing a friendly greeting string for a given name, implemented by [[code/greeter|greet]]. Work on this behavior is tracked outside the wiki in `specs/greeting-spec.md` and `plans/greeting-plan.md`.

## Notes

- Kept intentionally tiny: this whole fixture exists to give the View schema/validator and fixture-matrix tests one small, real, healthy workspace to point at.
